name: Library Hall
desc: Grand library interior in one-point perspective — bookshelf walls of colorful spines receding to an arched glowing window, perspective floorboards, three swaying hanging lamps with breathing glow pools, a rolling ladder inching along the stacks, and dust motes drifting through the lamplight. Styles: oxford oak, midnight blue, grand white, wizard's violet with green flames, cozy attic.
